answer: Latency-decayed reward vesting.** Each new identity’s earnings unlock only after a fixed delay tied to its oldest verified action, so value accrues slowly at first and reaches its nadir after weeks. An attacker must fund and operate every sybil through that entire delay, paying compute, accounts, and opportunity cost with no early payout. A legitimate haven emerges for patient participants; instant farmed timber gets nothing until the clock runs out. Cost scales linearly with identity count times delay length.
